Weekend Surprise

Saturday reveals.
Sunday happens.

A small, local plan each week for people who want to cross paths more naturally. No formal date, no crowded event calendar — just one good reason to leave the house.

How it works

One plan. A little mystery. A real Sunday.

01

A surprise appears

Every Saturday, one small Squad gathering is revealed in each live city.

02

You raise your hand

See the idea, the partner place, and why it may suit you. Request a place if it feels right.

03

Sunday happens

Meet at a familiar public venue with a small group of people who chose the same plan.

What might appear

A different reason to gather each week.

Every gathering stays small, local, and based around something easy to share.

Sunday · Delhi

Market Evening

Markets · Tea · Walking

Sunday · Bangalore

Courtyard Jazz

Live music · Slow evenings · Small circles

Sunday · Mumbai

Gallery after hours

Art walks · Design chats · City nights

The standard

Public places. Small groups. Nothing forced.

Gatherings happen at trusted partner venues and are always optional. You can talk first, arrive on your own terms, and leave whenever you need to. It is a gentler way to make your city feel more open.

Your next Sunday

Be there when the next plan drops.
